events.address: Union Square Plaza, Broadway between E 17th & E 18th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile Korean scalp-and-hair-care pop-up bringing Dr. Groot's scalp-first hair-care products, fragrances and regimen to Union Square.
events.what_is_free: Public entry and product exploration are advertised; no guaranteed take-home giveaway is claimed by the verified listing.
events.caveats: The current listing publishes date-specific hours: September 16 from 11 AM–7 PM and September 17 from 11 AM–5 PM. No advance RSVP requirement is published. Free samples or gifts are not inferred beyond the source.
events.practical_notes: Union Square Plaza on Broadway between East 17th and East 18th Streets. Separate occurrence hours are preserved for each day.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day public fragrance activation for KILIAN PARIS' Cocktails Collection in the Meatpacking District.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples are advertised; gifts with purchase are separate and require a purchase.
events.caveats: Current NYC Plugged and Average Socialite listings agree on Friday, September 18, 12–8 PM, Chelsea Triangle/401 W 14th St, and open-public access. Complimentary items are while supplies last; gifts with purchase are not represented as free giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 18, 12–8 PM at Chelsea Triangle. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.address: The Brant Foundation Gallery, 421 E 6th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: An immersive forest of flat-pack wooden sculpture by Cj Hendry and Sulwhasoo, inspired by the hidden garden at The House of Sulwhasoo in Seoul.
events.what_is_free: Public admission to the immersive installation is advertised as open to the public.
events.caveats: The current event calendar publishes September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at The Brant Foundation Gallery and explicitly says the installation is open to the public. No advance RSVP requirement is shown in the verified listing.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 421 E 6th St.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r — The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC pop-up, combining its comfort-focused fashion with sweet treats, photo moments, exclusive experiences and weekend surprises.
events.what_is_free: Public entry is free; the source advertises sweet treats and surprises but does not establish a guaranteed specific giveaway for every visitor.
events.caveats: Average Socialite and NYC for FREE agree on September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street and describe the pop-up as open to the public. Retail merchandise is available for purchase; unspecified surprises are not treated as guaranteed freebies.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 251 Elizabeth St. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified listings.
